seoTitle: How to Accept ACH Payments With Stripe (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Yes, Stripe supports ACH debit and credit transfers. Here's how to enable ACH payments, understand fees and processing time, and test them safely.
intro: A lot of business owners aren't sure whether Stripe even handles ACH payments — it does, but you need to switch it on yourself. This guide explains how ACH debit and ACH credit work on Stripe, where to activate them in your dashboard, and what to expect in terms of fees and processing time before you start accepting bank transfers from customers.

steps.heading: Understand ACH debit vs. ACH credit
steps.body: ACH debit pulls funds directly from a customer's bank account, while ACH credit is a transfer sent to you. Knowing the difference helps you pick the right option for your business.

steps.heading: Enable ACH payments in your Stripe dashboard
steps.body: ACH isn't active by default, so you'll need to turn it on in your account settings before customers can pay this way at checkout.

steps.heading: Check fees and processing times
steps.body: ACH transfers typically settle slower than card payments and carry their own fee structure, so review these details before promoting it as a payment option.

steps.heading: Test ACH payments in test mode
steps.body: Before going live, run a test transaction in Stripe's test mode to confirm the flow works as expected without moving real money.

faq.question: Does Stripe actually accept ACH payments?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe supports both ACH debit and ACH credit transfers, but you need to enable them in your account settings first.

faq.question: Is ACH faster or slower than card payments?
faq.answer: ACH generally takes longer to process than card payments since it relies on bank transfer rails rather than instant card authorization.

faq.question: Do all businesses qualify to accept ACH on Stripe?
faq.answer: Eligibility depends on your account type and business details, which is why the video covers what businesses need to qualify before enabling it.

faq.question: Can I test ACH payments before going live?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe's test mode lets you simulate ACH transactions so you can confirm everything works before accepting real payments.
